subject: Application Received – Next Steps with AY Migration Limited
latest_message:
Dear Applicant,

Thank you for submitting your application for the above role. At AY Migration Limited, we have supported more than 400 skilled professionals in building their careers in Australia, and we are delighted that you have chosen us to support your relocation journey.

As part of our assessment process, all candidates are required to complete a mandatory AI‑led interview. To begin, please click on the link that corresponds to your profession:

Registered Nurse  
Link:https://talent.flowmingo.ai/interview/39c6a697-0486-4fd0-89c8-475be6db2528/

Aged Carer  
Link:https://talent.flowmingo.ai/interview/2a038ab5-faad-4cc6-bb4b-aa4ad8d668f6/

Other Skilled Professionals  
Link:https://talent.flowmingo.ai/interview/a36ff012-7e9a-4a78-b899-f0330cb59eff/

Once you complete the interview, our recruitment team will review your submission. If successful, you will receive a confirmation of offer along with instructions on the documents required from you.
